text:
deploy-bot: Config-only deploy queued for tonight 22:00 UTC -> targeting canary group 'tinyburst-12'. Params: rate_limit 250->200 rps, idle_timeout 3s->1.5s, batch_window_ms 25->15, rollout plan 10% for 30m -> 50% 1h -> 100%. Reviewers: @sai @jules. /deploy plan attached. React :eyes: to acknowledge.
sai: ack, I'll watch latency dashboards + set up a short KV cache pressure smoke test.
jules: SG. I'm on-call tonight, can monitor tail-latency. Recommend reduce initial canary to 5% given expected traffic spike during window.
kevin: Quick Q: should we pin routing/model versions even though it's config-only? Last time a model drift added noise to metrics.
marta: ran a lightweight load locally — batch_window 15ms helps throughput but memory jumps on a sustained tail. Noted.
ops-bot: Preflight checks: cluster health OK, nodes=72, avg queue depth=3.4, free GPU mem across canary nodes=74%. No active alerts.
deploy-bot: Canary start scheduled now. Monitoring hooks: p50/p95 latency, queue_length, kvcache hit-rate, retry-rate. Abort condition: p95 > 2x baseline or retry-rate > 3x.
sai: OK seeing canary shards come up. Early signal: p95 from baseline 210ms -> 450ms on shard-3. Not comfortable.
jules: seeing retry spike + a few OOM-ish logs: ```rpc: failed to allocate 128MB for KV cache; node=canary-3```
kevin: sounds like KV pressure from tighter batch window. Proposal: revert batch_window to 25ms and cap max_batch_size to 8 tokens/batches to limit memory. Who can push a quick config hotfix to canary?
marta: I can open a hotfix and patch the canary only. ETA ~8m. Will include diff and rollout notes.
deploy-bot: Hotfix diff being applied to tinyburst-12 canary: `batch_window_ms: 15 -> 25`, `max_batch_tokens: 1024 -> 512`, `max_batch_items: unset -> 8`. Rolling patch to canary now.
ops-bot: Hotfix applied to canary nodes. Re-running health checks: free GPU mem now 70% (was 63% after deploy). Queue depth normalizing.
sai: p95 is trending back down to ~220ms. Nice. Keep canary at 10% for another 30m then ramp to 30% (as agreed on slack).
jules: Agree. Add to release notes: "reverted aggressive batch window reduction due to KV cache pressure; will investigate quantized path and memory accounting."
kevin: Also pin routing-policy to prefer 'lowlatency' tier for this rollout to avoid cross-traffic variability.
marta: done, pushed routing pin and updated release notes PR #478 with config diff and rollforward plan.
deploy-bot: Rollout progressed to 30% at ts=1766123470. We'll hold for 1hr of stability; rollback trigger remains p95 > 2x or new OOM errors. If we hit rollback, revert to config rev `rev=2026-03-18-rt2`.
sai: :thumbsup: leaving monitoring on. No further action unless alerts fire.
jules: I'll capture traces and attach a short postmortem if we see recurrence.
kevin: Thanks all — nice fast loop on the hotfix.
marta: noted for follow-up test matrix (KV pressure + batch window combos).
